turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello there! How's your day treating you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My partner snores and I'm waking up three times a night.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's rough. Do you want to try earplugs or a white noise machine first, or talk to your partner about seeing a doctor?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold on, my friend and I need to figure something out. Wait until I'm back, okay?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did he just say platform nine or platform five?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Nine, I think. The board still says five, though.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: The announcement. Boards are always behind.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Grace, nine's at the far end. We've got three minutes.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Then stop talking and run. Grab your bag.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait, the board just changed. Nine. Go, go, go.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, that took a while. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. We were talking about the snoring. Earplugs and white noise, or the doctor?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Earplugs first. I don't want to make a big deal of it yet.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fair enough. Soft foam ones work best, and roll them thin before you put them in.
